scope: A floating ColdFire cave that does not fit the clone window now goes to the overflow run before the window's overrun check, as the browser composer places it (requestedCaves). Two fresh native builds of 194 selections (the earlier builder records' selections still offered, plus every LOFI2 coverage selection without LOFI2), one with the base commit's build_bus.py and one with this one, in the pinned toolchain image with the static stock loader. 66 selections the declaration ledger refuses before any placement (colliding modules, identical text before and after) are left out of this record; the other 128 are listed. Every built image is identical (100) and no refused selection now builds. 10 refusals change their reason: the window assert no longer fires first, so the build refuses where the browser does (a DSP region overrun) or at the next placement that does not fit. On main, the browser comparison of the two refused EVERB selections goes from a refusal mismatch to a match; merged with LOFI2's branch, module:verify lofi2 reports 0 mismatches of 130 selections. No hardware result is inferred.
